xref.title: Youngest Bond Theme Performer (2020)
xref.body: Billie Eilish holds the distinction of being the youngest person ever to record a James Bond theme. She was 18 years old when she co-wrote and recorded "No Time to Die" with her brother Finneas O'Connell in late 2019. "Billy Eilish was 18 at the time this song was written and recorded. And that makes her the youngest person ever missing a Bond theme."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
